newsitem.title: USA: Signet Banking board elects McDonald CEO.
newsitem.headline: Signet Banking board elects McDonald CEO.

text.p: Signet Banking Corp said on Thursday its board elected Malcolm McDonald chairman and chief executive officer and T. Gaylon Layfield III president and chief operating officer effective at year-end 1996.

The company said the promotions complete a management transition after former Chairman Robert Freeman's retirement. Earlier last year, Wallace Millner was named vice chairman in addition to his role as chief financial officer, it said.
Freeman announced his decision to retire in early 1995.
Signet Banking Corp is an $11 billion multi-bank holding company that offers a variety of financial services through its capital markets, commercial banking and consumer banking businesses, it said.
